what: Two full-size runs of the delivery chain (tools/possession_deliver.py) with the default release configuration possession-release.json (possession-v2.11k first) on the synthetic rehearsal bundle A of K003 (file names, record counts and slot counts of the provided files; content: corrupted Metrica sample games; an invented stretch before the second-half kick-off). Wiring and size check, reporting only. Nothing here is from the provided match and nothing was selected with it.
environment: chain under Python 3.10.20 / numpy 1.26.4 / scipy 1.11.4 / pandas 2.1.4 (Linux); scoring under 3.13.18 / numpy 2.5.3 against stored labels (truth_stable.npz, the file-order Metrica proxy labels of K005; no label is recomputed)

run_1_with_an_invented_smart_tagging_fil.bundle: bundle A plus tactical/BAR-ATH_tactical_smart_tagging.xml written by experiments/possession_v2/prova_tagging.py: the structure DATA.md describes (638 instances, the published code and set-piece type counts); the two Kick Off (Start) instances are 5 s windows that start 50 and 60 frames before the two kick-offs the bundle was laid out on (frames 11135 and 113682); everything else in it is random
run_1_with_an_invented_smart_tagging_fil.options: --no-public-check --no-clone-check --quick (tests and cross-platform check included); simulated clock readings of K003
run_1_with_an_invented_smart_tagging_fil.tool_note: run before the VERI line of the tool was extended (it did not yet say whether the Smart Tagging file is present)

limits: The Smart Tagging file of run 1 is invented by us around kick-off frames we chose; it says nothing about the tags of the provided file.
The scores are agreement with Metrica proxy labels on a synthetic layout; they are not competition scores.
Both runs used --quick: no repeat run, no run without clock readings, no fresh clone.
